# McClay's Logistics USA LLC

McClay's Logistics USA LLC is a Transportation, Logistics, Supply Chain and Storage company. McClay's Transportation & Logistics is a company that provides transportation, logistics, cross border, cross-docking, dedicated drayage, expedited, final mile delivery, flatbed, ftl, ltl, refrigerated, vehicle hauling, and warehousing services. McClay's Logistics USA LLC employs 37 people (+23.3% YoY, +7 people), founded in 2019. Headquartered in Warren, Michigan, United States.

## About

McClay's Group of Companies has become a leading provider of transportation, logistics, and warehousing solutions.

-> With a fleet of over 200 vehicles and a team of experienced drivers, McClay's Group of Companies operates throughout Canada and the United States, offering reliable and efficient freight transportation services.

-> Throughout our growth and expansion, McClay's Logistics exploded onto the scene in 2019 and has remained committed to providing exceptional customer service and meeting the evolving needs of our clients. We pride ourselves on our ability to deliver goods on time, ensuring customer/carrier satisfaction.

-> As a family-owned company, we value our employees and recognize their contributions to the company's success. We provide a safe and supportive work environment, encouraging professional growth and development.

-> With over 30 years of experience in the transportation and logistics industry, McClay's Group of Companies has established a strong reputation for reliability, efficiency, and customer satisfaction. We are dedicated to continued growth and innovation, ensuring we remain at the forefront of the industry.

# McClay's Transportation USA LLC

McClay's Transportation USA LLC is a Truck Transportation company. McClay's Transportation & Logistics is a company that provides transportation, logistics, cross border, cross-docking, dedicated drayage, expedited, final mile delivery, flatbed, ftl, ltl, refrigerated, vehicle hauling, and warehousing services. McClay's Transportation USA LLC employs 13 people, founded in 2013. Headquartered in Detroit, Michigan, United States, with presence in Canada. Its workforce is distributed across United States and Canada.

## About

McClay’s Transportation USA is a family-owned, asset-based transportation provider headquartered in Detroit, MI. With 100+ company-owned trucks operating across MI, NC, GA, CO, IN, and KY, we deliver dependable, on-time transportation—backed by real assets and real accountability.

We help companies and shippers reduce liability, increase efficiency, and eliminate waste through disciplined operations and transparent partnerships. Our experienced drivers, modern equipment, and safety-first culture ensure your freight moves reliably, every time.

Safety is our top priority—for our drivers and your freight. That commitment led us to develop our Fleet Integration Partnership Program, a unique approach designed to reduce liability, risk, and administrative burden while uncovering operational opportunities that improve flow, responsiveness, and profitability for our partners.

We don’t just haul freight.
We help our partners operate smarter.

Put your growth in the fast lane with McClay’s Transportation USA.
